name: jumphp/dialogue
description: Dialogues and quests for JumPHP games: branching conversations with conditions and variables, a quest log, a typewriter text box, all from JSON files

jumphp.name: Dialogue
jumphp.summary: Branching dialogues with conditions and variables, a quest log and a typewriter text box, written as JSON files and checked when loaded.
features: .dialogue.json files: nodes, choices, conditions (gold >= 5 && !helped), set / action, {variables} in the text
Variables and a QuestLog (objectives with counts, started / progress / done / failed events) that dialogues can read and drive
DialogueRunner: start, line(), advance(), choose(); actions go to your code
DialogueBox: the text letter by letter, choices with a cursor, sized to the view
Errors say where (the dialogue, the node, the choice); save and restore of the whole state; pure PHP, 32-bit safe
